DogBoard

DogBoard, a private Android keyboard with autocorrect that fixes typos the way you expect. Releases from https://github.com/silly-puppyy/DogBoard, signed by the DogBoard maintainers.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://silly-puppyy.github.io/DogBoard-fdroid/repo
